entities.summary: Vance Desmond Joseph is an American professional football coach and former player who is the defensive coordinator for the Denver Broncos of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Colorado Buffaloes as a quarterback and running back in the 1990s, and was signed by the New York Jets as an undrafted free agent in 1995, playing cornerback for them and then the Indianapolis Colts in 1996. After spending 12 years as a defensive coach in the NFL with the San Francisco 49ers, Houston Texans, Cincinnati Bengals, and Miami Dolphins, Joseph was hired by the Broncos to be their head coach in 2017 before getting fired after the 2018 season.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a defensive coordinator for the Denver Broncos and former player, Vance Joseph has had a significant impact on the NFL, particularly in the realm of defensive strategy. His tenure as head coach from 2017 to 2018 marked a turning point for the team, although his overall legacy is still being written.
